resources.desc: Web tool that traces contour lines from real elevation data (a global bare-earth terrain model, plus national lidar in several countries) and exports them as SVG, PNG, DXF or GeoJSON. The editor's light and dark vector basemap runs on MapLibre GL JS with OpenFreeMap tiles.

resources.name: Utopia Map
resources.desc: Collaborative map-based app for decentralized coordination and real-life networking.

resources.name: Vienna Living Map
resources.desc: Free housing map of Vienna: hours of direct sun per address and floor, calculated in the browser from measured building heights, plus noise, green space, transit and summer heat. Built with MapLibre GL JS on self-hosted PMTiles; no account, no cookies.

resources.name: VivaMap
resources.desc: Quality-of-life map of every Swiss commune (tax, public transport, schools, noise, air quality, sunshine, nature, restaurants, healthcare) and every Dutch municipality (vivamap.nl). Scores are computed on an H3 hexagon grid and rendered with MapLibre GL JS, deck.gl and PMTiles on a static site.

resources.name: Walkably
resources.desc: Free walkability map of Europe: type any address and see how walkable it is. Every street is scored from OpenStreetMap data. MapLibre GL JS reads a single PMTiles file on Cloudflare R2, over OpenFreeMap tiles; a static site with no accounts.

resources.name: World Train Map
resources.desc: Interactive atlas of over a thousand notable train routes worldwide, colour-coded by type on OpenFreeMap tiles. Built with MapLibre GL JS; free rail dataset as GeoJSON/CSV.

resources.name: Wynd's
resources.desc: Property research website in Australia with flood risk, bushfire risk and school zone maps built with MapLibre JS.

resources.name: Yapmap
resources.desc: Free, voice-controlled 3D world map: tap to talk and an AI guide flies the globe anywhere, drops pins, draws routes and narrates each place. Built with MapLibre GL JS 5, with deck.gl Tile3DLayer over Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles for close-up city dives. Runs in the browser, no account.

resources.name: Zornade
resources.desc: Italian cadastral parcel intelligence platform aggregating 15+ public data sources (hydrogeological risk, real estate prices, demographics) into a per-parcel profile covering 85 million cadastral parcels, with a free REST API. Uses MapLibre GL JS.

resources.name: Expo MapLibre native + web demo
resources.desc: Demo Expo app using maplibre-react-native for native, and falling back to react-map-gl with maplibre-gl-js for web.
